name: obsidian-bases
description: Create and edit Obsidian Bases (.base YAML files) with views, filters, formulas, and summaries. Trigger when the user opens or edits a .base file, or says "make a base", "build a database view of my notes", "add a filter/formula to this base", "create a table/card view", "query my vault". Not for .md notes (obsidian-markdown) or .canvas files (json-canvas).
